answer: A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 15 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The quill chain is verified at intake and vault publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 15 epochs old, anchored at a island checkpoint. That bill is paid per identity, so 53 aliases cost 345 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
